 Lakers latest injury report: Who's out vs. Raptors on Sunday? 
 2026-11-01 16:02 
 The Los Angeles Lakers will be without sophomore forward Adou Thiero on Sunday against the Raptors, while Ziaire Williams has been listed as questionable for tonight's game.
 Credit: Imagn Images - Scanpix 
 Credit Imagn Images - Scanpix 
 Credit Imagn Images - Scanpix 
 Add us on 
 Add us on 
 The Los Angeles Lakers are set to host the Toronto Raptors with nearly their full-strength roster at their disposal on Sunday.
 Ahead of tonight's game in Los Angeles, three players have been listed on the injury report.
 Out of the three, Lakers center Walker Kessler has been listed as available, despite dealing with a left finger splint.
 Meanwhile, second-year forward Adou Thiero has been ruled out once again for the Lakers with a left knee injury.
 There is also uncertainty surrounding the availability of forward Ziaire Williams , who has been listed as questionable due to a left foot injury.
 Kawhi Leonard remains sidelined for Raptors
 For the Raptors, Kawhi Leonard is set to miss multiple weeks due to a left knee injury.
 The Lakers enter the matchup with a 4-2 record, coming off a tough NBA Cup loss to the Warriors, while the Raptors are 3-2 after the first five games of the season.
 Tonight's game at Crypto.com Arena will tip off at 9 PM ET.
